name: Bigby's Hand

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature within 5 feet of the hand

upcast.text: The fist's damage rises by 2d8 and the crush by 2d6 per slot level above 5.

sustain.label: Bigby's Hand: fist
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the hand moves up to 60 ft and punches a creature within 5 ft of it (melee spell attack, 5d8 Force).

sustain.label: Bigby's Hand: shove
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the hand moves and shoves a Huge or smaller creature within 5 ft of it (Strength save).

sustain.label: Bigby's Hand: grasp
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the hand moves and tries to grab a Huge or smaller creature within 5 ft of it (Dexterity save).

sustain.label: Bigby's Hand: crush
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the hand crushes the creature it holds.

sustain.label: Bigby's Hand: shield
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the hand shields you (Half Cover until your next turn).

summary: A Large hand of force that punches, shoves, grabs or shields at your command.
text: The hand has AC 20 and your Hit Point maximum. When it appears and as a Bonus Action later, it moves up to 60 ft and then strikes (melee spell attack, 5d8 Force), pushes (Str save), grapples (Dex save; crush for 4d6 + your modifier Bludgeoning) or shields you with Half Cover.
